title: Separate AuthListenable from AuthRepository
objective: Remove ChangeNotifier responsibility from AuthRepository and route refresh behavior through a dedicated AuthListenable.
acceptance_criteria: IAuthRepository no longer imports Flutter widgets or extends ChangeNotifier
lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_listenable.dart exists with AuthListenable extends ChangeNotifier and a public notify method
Provider setup registers IAuthRepository as a plain provider and AuthListenable as the listenable provider
GoRouter.refreshListenable receives AuthListenable instead of AuthRepository
AuthCubit or equivalent auth orchestration notifies AuthListenable after login, signUp, logout, and resetPassword state mutations where route refresh is required
flutter analyze lib/ reports no new errors
deliverables: Updated provider graph, router signature, main app wiring, and auth cubit notifications
